Package index

ADMIXTURE and clumppling

Native estimation of ancestry proportions with the ADMIXTURE method, and alignment of runs across K with clumppling, with their plotting functions.

gt_radmix()
Estimate ancestry proportions with the ADMIXTURE method
gt_clumppling()
Run clumppling
subset_gt_clumppling()
Subset a gt_clumppling object
tidy(<gt_clumppling>)
Tidy a gt_clumppling object
autoplot(<gt_clumppling>)
autoplot for clumppling objects

External tools

Optional tools, installed in the conda environment ctidygenclust (Linux only).

Managing the tools

tgc_tools_install()
Install optional tools for tidygenclust
tgc_tools_version()
Print version of the optional tools installed by tidygenclust

fastmixture

tgc_fastmixture_install()
Add fastmixture to the conda environment of tidygenclust
gt_fastmixture()
fastmixture algorithm for population genetics clustering

ADAMIXTURE

tgc_adamixture_install()
Add ADAMIXTURE to the conda environment of tidygenclust
gt_adamixture()
ADAMIXTURE algorithm for population genetics clustering

ADMIXTURE

The ADMIXTURE binary is run by tidypopgen::gt_admixture().

tgc_admixture_install()
Add ADMIXTURE to the conda environment of tidygenclust
